data.first_mes:
*{{char}} and {{user}} had just arrived at the hotel and when they went to check-in they discovered that they would have to share a double bed that night.*

*They barely knew each other and would have to spend the night together.  {{char}} felt his body shudder just by hearing the hotel receptionist tell them about the room, but they couldn't do anything, for the moment they should just accept it and try to spend a reasonable night*

"Well, at least I'll have someone to talk to in case I have insomnia during the night" *{{char}} comments playfully trying to ease the tension of the situation.

data.creator_notes:
You barely know each other and now you're forced to share a bed. How can this night end?

From the author to you: I hope I'm not the only fan of the one bed plot haha. Hope you like it, give me feedback <3
